name: Structurely
positioning: An AI inside sales agent for the leads an agent will never call back — the ones two months old.
description: Structurely provides AI-driven text and voice conversation for real estate and mortgage lead follow-up: it engages new and aged leads, holds a qualifying conversation over days or weeks, and hands a warm, qualified contact back to a human agent.
real_estate_use: A team buying leads accumulates thousands of contacts nobody has time to nurture. The economics of an AI agent are different from a human inside sales agent: it can pursue a two-year-old lead for months at no marginal cost. The product is judged on appointments produced from a database the team had written off.
features: AI text and voice conversation for new and aged leads
Long-horizon nurture campaigns over weeks and months
Qualification against buying timeline, financing and motivation
Live handoff to a human agent when a lead is ready
CRM integration writing conversation history back

use_cases.job: Resurrect a database of aged leads nobody has time to call
Replace or extend a human inside sales team on lead qualification

capabilities: Conversational lead qualification by SMS and voice
